methodology.benchmark_universe: S&P 500 point-in-time at initial date via pitindex
methodology.execution: signals at close, trades at next session open; initial ranking uses prior close and executes first-day open
methodology.buy_formula: 40% relative strength 20d + 25% return 60d + 20% trend + 10% RVOL + 5% RSI
methodology.sell_formula: 100 - current buy-quality score; sell when deterioration >= 70
methodology.benchmark_definition: Top 100 S&P500 names by same formula on initial signal day; buy $1 each and hold for entire period
